slug: 2024-09-18 Seychelles Makes Digital ID Mandatory for Work Permit Holders

SYC.note: Certificates are delivered by CertExpress, but no exchange of records between the civil register and the ID system is stated.
No count or share of people holding an ID is given.
No number at birth is mentioned.
WISeKey developed SeyID, but the document does not say who operates or maintains it.
No public register keyed on the ID number is mentioned.

facts.fact: ID Tech, citing Seychelles News Agency, reports SeyID was officially launched on 1 November 2022 and from 17 September 2024 is mandatory as a virtual ID for new work permit holders, valid for the permit's duration.
